definitions.largestMove: Largest absolute change in daily mean price between consecutive published days for the same node within the last 7 days.
definitions.notable: Latest daily mean is at least 1.5x or at most 0.5x of that node's median daily mean over the last 30 published days. A flag, not an anomaly conclusion.
definitions.regionalSpread: Difference between the highest and lowest representative-node daily mean prices on the latest available trading day. Nodal prices, not city-wide averages.
definitions.status: Final prices are declared after the pricing-error window. Interim prices are provisional and may change.
definitions.volatility: Sample standard deviation of half-hourly nodal prices within the last 7 calendar days ($/MWh).
